question: Estimate the number of dental clinics in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All dental practices: standalone + hospital-attached + dental chains (Clove, Sabka Dentist, etc.)? Yes.
Active practitioners with dental practice? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian active dentists: ~3 lakh (per Dental Council of India).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Net unique dental clinics: ~1.7-1.8 lakh standalone + ~5,000 multi-dentist clinics.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1.8 lakh dental clinics in India.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~10% with avg 3 dentists = subtract ~30K from clinic count.

calculationFlow: Indian active dentists: ~3 lakh (per Dental Council of India).
Of these, with own clinic: ~70% = 2.1 lakh.
Of clinics, multi-dentist (chains, hospital-attached): ~10% with avg 3 dentists = subtract ~30K from clinic count.
Net unique dental clinics: ~1.7-1.8 lakh standalone + ~5,000 multi-dentist clinics.
Round: ~1.8 lakh dental clinics in India.
